citations.claim: First pole_upright violation: theta -0.887 rad exceeds 0.8 limit, cart at x 1.61 still in track but pole fallen
System energy at violating step shows large controller work injected
One step before violation pole already at -0.688 rad and diverging with omega -9.55

explanation: With dt=0.02, sensor_noise=0.02, light cart (0.5) and offset initial state (x=0.5,v=0.5,theta=0.1), the state-feedback controller saturates at force_limit 40 (observed 40 at steps 9-11) and cannot stabilize. Pole angle diverges from -0.507 at step 9 to -0.688 at step 10 to -0.887 at step 11, exceeding 0.8 limit while cart velocity grows to 11.1 m/s. Likely cause is controller saturation combined with coarse dt and noisy feedback making recovery impossible.
vision_note: The cart drifts steadily to the right while the pole tilts increasingly to the left across steps 8 to 10. At step 11 the pole is leaning sharply far from upright and its tip turns red, marking the pole_upright violation.
